```{r}
save <- here("Morphology","IPL Depth Script")

file_path <- here("data", "rawdata.xlsx")

# Function to read a sheet with the first row as column names and skip second row
read_sheet_with_names <- function(sheet_name) {
  raw <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = sheet_name, col_names = FALSE)
  colnames <- raw %>% slice(1) %>% unlist() %>% as.character()
  colnames[1] <- "Distance"
  data <- raw %>% slice(-c(1,2))
  names(data) <- colnames
  data
}

# Read all 3 sheets properly
s2s4_raw <- read_sheet_with_names("s2s4")
gfp_raw  <- read_sheet_with_names("stratification")
th_raw   <- read_sheet_with_names("s1")

# Convert all columns except Distance to numeric
s2s4_raw <- s2s4_raw %>% mutate(across(-Distance, as.numeric))
gfp_raw  <- gfp_raw  %>% mutate(across(-Distance, as.numeric))
th_raw   <- th_raw   %>% mutate(across(-Distance, as.numeric))

# Scale Distance to 0–100
scale_0_100 <- function(x) {
  100 * (x - min(x, na.rm=TRUE)) / (max(x, na.rm=TRUE) - min(x, na.rm=TRUE))
}
s2s4_scaled <- s2s4_raw %>% mutate(Distance = scale_0_100(as.numeric(Distance)))
gfp_scaled  <- gfp_raw  %>% mutate(Distance = scale_0_100(as.numeric(Distance)))
th_scaled   <- th_raw   %>% mutate(Distance = scale_0_100(as.numeric(Distance)))

# Normalize s2s4 gray values to 0–1
gray_cols_s2s4 <- setdiff(names(s2s4_scaled), "Distance")
s2s4_scaled[gray_cols_s2s4] <- s2s4_scaled[gray_cols_s2s4] %>%
  map_df(~(.x - min(.x, na.rm=TRUE)) / (max(.x, na.rm=TRUE) - min(.x, na.rm=TRUE)))

# Normalize GFP gray values to 0–1
gray_cols_gfp <- setdiff(names(gfp_scaled), "Distance")
gfp_scaled[gray_cols_gfp] <- gfp_scaled[gray_cols_gfp] %>%
  map_df(~(.x - min(.x, na.rm=TRUE)) / (max(.x, na.rm=TRUE) - min(.x, na.rm=TRUE)))

# Normalize TH gray values to 0–1
gray_cols_th <- setdiff(names(th_scaled), "Distance")
th_scaled[gray_cols_th] <- th_scaled[gray_cols_th] %>%
  map_df(~(.x - min(.x, na.rm=TRUE)) / (max(.x, na.rm=TRUE) - min(.x, na.rm=TRUE)))

# Pivot longer
s2s4_long <- pivot_longer(s2s4_scaled, -Distance, names_to="Cell", values_to="s2s4_Value")
gfp_long  <- pivot_longer(gfp_scaled,  -Distance, names_to="Cell", values_to="GFP_Value")
th_long   <- pivot_longer(th_scaled,   -Distance, names_to="Cell", values_to="TH_Value")

# Smooth s2s4
s2s4_smoothed <- s2s4_long %>%
  group_by(Cell) %>%
  arrange(Distance) %>%
  mutate(Smoothed = slide_dbl(s2s4_Value, mean, .before=1, .after=1, .complete=TRUE)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Find local maxima in s2s4
s2s4_peaks <- s2s4_smoothed %>%
  group_by(Cell) %>%
  mutate(
    lag = lag(Smoothed),
    lead = lead(Smoothed),
    is_peak = Smoothed > lag & Smoothed > lead
  ) %>%
  filter(is_peak) %>%
  arrange(Cell, desc(Smoothed)) %>%
  group_by(Cell) %>%
  mutate(height_rank = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup()

# Among the 2 tallest, pick the leftmost
first_tallest_peaks <- s2s4_peaks %>%
  filter(height_rank <= 2) %>%
  group_by(Cell) %>%
  arrange(Distance) %>%
  slice(1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(Cell, Peak_Distance = Distance)

# Shift s2s4 distances
s2s4_aligned <- s2s4_smoothed %>%
  left_join(first_tallest_peaks, by="Cell") %>%
  mutate(Aligned_Distance = Distance - Peak_Distance)

# Shift GFP distances
gfp_aligned <- gfp_long %>%
  left_join(first_tallest_peaks, by="Cell") %>%
  mutate(Aligned_Distance = Distance - Peak_Distance)

# Shift TH distances
th_aligned <- th_long %>%
  left_join(first_tallest_peaks, by="Cell") %>%
  mutate(Aligned_Distance = Distance - Peak_Distance)

# Combine all for plotting
plot_data <- bind_rows(
  s2s4_aligned %>% mutate(Channel = "s2s4", Value = s2s4_Value),
  gfp_aligned  %>% mutate(Channel = "GFP",  Value = GFP_Value),
  th_aligned   %>% mutate(Channel = "TH",   Value = TH_Value)
)

# Bin width
bin_width <- 0.2

# Bin and summarize s2s4
s2s4_binned <- plot_data %>%
  filter(Channel == "s2s4") %>%
  mutate(Bin = floor(Aligned_Distance / bin_width) * bin_width) %>%
  group_by(Bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm=TRUE),
    sem = sd(Value, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Bin and summarize TH
th_binned <- plot_data %>%
  filter(Channel == "TH") %>%
  mutate(Bin = floor(Aligned_Distance / bin_width) * bin_width) %>%
  group_by(Bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(Value, na.rm=TRUE),
    sem = sd(Value, na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Plot
ggplot() +
  # s2s4 mean + SEM
  geom_ribbon(
    data = s2s4_binned,
    aes(
      x = Bin,
      ymin = mean_value - sem,
      ymax = mean_value + sem
    ),
    fill = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = s2s4_binned,
    aes(
      x = Bin,
      y = mean_value
    ),
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # TH mean + SEM
  geom_ribbon(
    data = th_binned,
    aes(
      x = Bin,
      ymin = mean_value - sem,
      ymax = mean_value + sem
    ),
    fill = "black",
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = th_binned,
    aes(
      x = Bin,
      y = mean_value
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # GFP individual lines
  geom_line(
    data = plot_data %>% filter(Channel == "GFP"),
    aes(
      x = Aligned_Distance,
      y = Value,
      group = Cell
    ),
    color = "forestgreen",
    linewidth = 2,
    alpha = 0.7
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-50, 50),
    breaks = seq(-50, 50, by = 25)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "s2s4 and TH Mean ± SEM (Binned), GFP Individual Profiles",
    x = "Aligned Distance (0 = First of 2 Tallest s2s4 Peaks)",
    y = "Normalized Signal (0–1)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()


ggplot() +
  # s2s4 mean + SEM
  geom_ribbon(
    data = s2s4_binned,
    aes(
      x = Bin,
      ymin = mean_value - sem,
      ymax = mean_value + sem
    ),
    fill = "grey80",
    alpha = 0.5
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = s2s4_binned,
    aes(
      x = Bin,
      y = mean_value
    ),
    color = "grey40",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  # TH mean + SEM
  geom_ribbon(
    data = th_binned,
    aes(
      x = Bin,
      ymin = mean_value - sem,
      ymax = mean_value + sem
    ),
    fill = "black",
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = th_binned,
    aes(
      x = Bin,
      y = mean_value
    ),
    color = "black",
    linewidth = 1
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "s2s4 and TH Mean ± SEM (Binned), GFP Individual Profiles",
    x = "Aligned Distance (0 = First of 2 Tallest s2s4 Peaks)",
    y = "Normalized Signal (0–1)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
   scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-5, 25),
    breaks = seq(-5, 25, by = 1)
  ) 
```

```{r}
# Read Reconstruction sheet
recon <- read_excel(file_path, sheet = "Reconstructions")

# Inspect and ensure column names are correct
head(recon)

# Make sure "File" and "Group" exist
# Rename File column if needed
names(recon)[names(recon) == "File"] <- "Cell"

gfp_grouped <- gfp_aligned %>%
  left_join(recon %>% select(Cell, Assignment), by = "Cell")

# Check that all cells got a group
if (any(is.na(gfp_grouped$Assignment))) {
  warning("Some cells did not match any Assignment!")
}

# List all unique Cell names in your gfp_aligned
cells_in_gfp <- unique(gfp_aligned$Cell)

# List all unique Cells in the reconstruction sheet
cells_in_recon <- unique(recon$Cell)

# Find which ones are missing
missing_cells <- setdiff(cells_in_gfp, cells_in_recon)

# Show them
print("Cells in GFP data with NO matching Group:")
print(missing_cells)


```

```{r}
# Join Group info to aligned GFP
gfp_grouped <- gfp_aligned %>%
  left_join(recon %>% select(Cell, Assignment), by = "Cell") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Assignment))

# Bin and summarize within each Group
bin_width <- 1

gfp_binned_group <- gfp_grouped %>%
  mutate(Bin = floor(Aligned_Distance / bin_width) * bin_width) %>%
  group_by(Assignment, Bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(GFP_Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(GFP_Value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n())
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Exclude Unclassified
gfp_binned_group_filtered <- gfp_binned_group %>%
  filter(Assignment != "Unclassified")

custom_colors <- c(
  "Alpha ON" = "#009967",       
  "Alpha OFF" = "#006b99",      
  "Asymmetric" = "#1b0099",     
  "Non-Alpha" = "#540099",      
  "Equal Bistratified" = "#950099",  
  "Unequal Bistratified" = "#990032" 
)

gfp_binned_group_filtered$Assignment <- factor(
  gfp_binned_group_filtered$Assignment,
  levels = c(
    "Alpha ON",
    "Alpha OFF",
    "Asymmetric",
    "Non-Alpha",
    "Equal Bistratified",
    "Unequal Bistratified"
  )
)

s2s4_binned$Assignment <- "s2s4"
th_binned$Assignment <- "TH"
ref_binned <- bind_rows(s2s4_binned, th_binned)
stratification_refs <- ggplot() +
  geom_ribbon(
    data = ref_binned,
    aes(
      x = Bin,
      ymin = mean_value - sem,
      ymax = mean_value + sem,
      fill = Assignment
    ),
    alpha = 0.3
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = ref_binned,
    aes(
      x = Bin,
      y = mean_value,
      color = Assignment
    ),
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("s2s4" = "grey40", "TH" = "black")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("s2s4" = "grey80", "TH" = "black")) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-15, 25),
    breaks = seq(-15, 25, by = 15)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = NULL,
    x = "Aligned Distance",
    y = "Normalized Signal"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ Assignment, nrow = 1)

stratification_refs

ggsave("stratification_ref.pdf", plot = stratification_refs, path = save, width = 8, height = 3, dpi = 300)


```

```{r}
# Join Group info to aligned GFP
gfp_grouped <- gfp_aligned %>%
  left_join(recon %>% select(Cell, Assignment), by = "Cell") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Assignment), Assignment != "Unclassified")

bin_width <- 1

# First: bin each individual cell
gfp_binned_cell <- gfp_grouped %>%
  mutate(Bin = floor(Aligned_Distance / bin_width) * bin_width) %>%
  group_by(Assignment, Cell, Bin) %>%
  summarise(
    value = mean(GFP_Value, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Then: calculate group mean + SEM from the individual cell-binned values
gfp_binned_group <- gfp_binned_cell %>%
  group_by(Assignment, Bin) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_value = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    sem = sd(value, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

custom_colors <- c(
  "Alpha ON" = "#009967",       
  "Alpha OFF" = "#006b99",      
  "Asymmetric" = "#1b0099",     
  "Non-Alpha" = "#540099",      
  "Equal Bistratified" = "#950099",  
  "Unequal Bistratified" = "#990032" 
)

group_levels <- c(
  "Alpha ON",
  "Alpha OFF",
  "Asymmetric",
  "Non-Alpha",
  "Equal Bistratified",
  "Unequal Bistratified"
)

gfp_binned_cell$Assignment <- factor(gfp_binned_cell$Assignment, levels = group_levels)
gfp_binned_group$Assignment <- factor(gfp_binned_group$Assignment, levels = group_levels)

stratification <- ggplot() +
  # group SEM ribbon
  geom_ribbon(
    data = gfp_binned_group,
    aes(
      x = Bin,
      ymin = mean_value - sem,
      ymax = mean_value + sem,
      fill = Assignment
    ),
    alpha = 0.25
  ) +
  # group mean line
  geom_line(
    data = gfp_binned_group,
    aes(
      x = Bin,
      y = mean_value,
      color = Assignment
    ),
    linewidth = 2
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = custom_colors) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    limits = c(-15, 25),
    breaks = seq(-15, 25, by = 15)
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Aligned Distance",
    y = "Normalized Signal",
    color = "Assignment",
    fill = "Assignment"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "none"
  ) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~ Assignment, nrow = 1)

stratification

ggsave("stratification.pdf", plot = stratification, path = save, width = 8.25, height = 3, dpi = 300)

```

```{r}
# Vector to control display/order
levels_vec <- c(
  "Alpha ON",
  "Alpha OFF",
  "Asymmetric",
  "Non-Alpha",
  "Equal Bistratified",
  "Unequal Bistratified"
)

# Count unique Cells per Group from your joined data
group_counts <- gfp_aligned %>%
  left_join(recon %>% select(Cell, Assignment), by = "Cell") %>%
  filter(!is.na(Assignment), Assignment != "Unclassified") %>%
  distinct(Assignment, Cell) %>%
  count(Assignment, name = "n") %>%
  # keep only groups that actually appear, then order by your preferred sequence
  mutate(Assignment = factor(Assignment, levels = levels_vec)) %>%
  arrange(Assignment)

# Build and print the message
parts <- paste0(as.character(group_counts$Assignment), " (n=", group_counts$n, ")")
total_n <- sum(group_counts$n)

cat("Groups and sample sizes: ", paste(parts, collapse = ", "),
    sprintf(" | Total N = %d\n", total_n), sep = "")
```
